You can't find oil ten feet from the surface.

Kevin Trudeau uses an oil driller to make a point about success. Drill ten feet here and ten feet there and you only end up with lots of shallow holes.

He says the treasure comes from picking one spot and going down hundreds of feet.

Where in your life are you digging lots of shallow holes?

#ad #success #mindset #kevintrudeau

"That's a stupid statement." That was Kevin's first reaction.

His mentors gave him one sentence: when your attitude's right, the facts don't count. He sat there with his notepad and thought that facts obviously count.

But the people in front of him were wealthy, calm and certain in a way he had never seen. He knew he was listening to the right people.

When did you last dismiss an idea too fast?
